meta.description: FlyWire LC4/LPLC2 -> DNp01 (Giant Fiber) escape convergence sub-circuit.
meta.edge_definition: An edge exists iff the (pre,post) pair appears in proofread_connections_783.feather. That file is NOT thresholded: min syn_count observed across all 16847997 rows = 1, so an edge here means >=1 synapse. FlyWire/Codex commonly display only connections with syn_count >= 5; both views are recorded below. Synapse counts are summed over neuropils per (pre,post) pair.
